name: Venecia (Antioquia, Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Venecia (a mountain on white within a red border) with the motto FUTURO Y PROGRESO on a scroll above.
history: Municipal flag of Venecia, a municipality in the department of Antioquia, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Venecia arms — mountain on white within a red border, with motto scroll FUTURO Y PROGRESO
